fallback.note: Each hit carries its own descriptive metadata, so demo/js/search.js can render FALLBACK MODE from this file alone — no items_meta.json, no .bin, no vendored model. This is the documented degradation path of cut-order item #2.

reference.computed_against: float32 L2-normalised view of the fp16 embeddings.npy slice (exact, not the int8 payload)

reference.tie_break: score descending, ties by ascending payload row

int8_parity.note: Export-side quantization parity: the int8 payload's own top-k against the exact fp16 reference. The browser adds the ONNX-model half of the gap; the exhibit's parity receipt reports the combined overlap.
